info.title: XamlNexus - Windows desktop prototype scaffolding
info.description: Quickly generate Windows desktop application prototypes using the .NET CLI scaffolding tool, based on common XAML frameworks such as WPF and WinUI 3.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Quick start:
xamlnexus new MyApp
cd MyApp
xamlnexus run
Stop with Ctrl+C before editing or running again.
Edit MyApp.MainPanel/MainPage.xaml and ViewModels/MainViewModel.cs.
xamlnexus page add Workspace
xamlnexus run
After stopping: xamlnexus add sqlite, then xamlnexus run.
